description.zh: 把一个话题的绿色 cosmic-plan 产物中规划（新增或修改）的模块同步回工作区级项目上下文，产出刷新后的绿色上下文；计划阶段通过后即可使用（工作区级；上游传入绿色上下文与话题计划）。
description.en: Sync the modules planned in one topic's green cosmic-plan artifact (added or modified) back into the workspace-level project context, producing a refreshed green context; usable once the plan stage passes (workspace scope; pass the green context and topic plan as upstream).

description.zh: 模块树深度（1-3）：合并后产物的实际树深必须等于它（rule context/module-depth）；从上游上下文回执继承
description.en: Depth of the module tree (1-3): the merged artifact's actual tree depth must equal it (rule context/module-depth); inherited from the upstream context receipt
